dct_description_sm: "Italie Beschreibungnach aller" at top, in gothic script; “ccxb” above.
Appears in Munster’s Cosmographia universalis, German edition, published between 1544 and 1628.
This copy has pencil inscription in lower left: 148.
Text on verso, entitled: Italie Beschreibungnach...
